scorecard.venue: Punjab Cricket Association IS Bindra Stadium, Mohali, Chandigarh

batting.name: V Kohli
batting.dismissal: c JM Sharma b Harpreet Brar

batting.name: F du Plessis
batting.dismissal: c SM Curran b NT Ellis

batting.name: GJ Maxwell
batting.dismissal: c Atharva Taide b Harpreet Brar

batting.name: KD Karthik
batting.dismissal: c Atharva Taide b Arshdeep Singh

batting.name: JM Sharma
batting.dismissal: c Shahbaz Ahmed b HV Patel

batting.name: M Shahrukh Khan
batting.dismissal: st KD Karthik b PWH de Silva

balls.text: short delivery outside off stump. Shahbaz waits in his crease and cuts it towards deep cover point. He then scampers back for the second and makes it in the end
back of a length delivery on middle and off stump. Lomror hoicks it towards deep mid wicket and the batters are content with just a single
short and wide outside off stump. Shahbaz gets up on his toes and drags it towards long on for one
full delivery outside off stump. Shahbaz throws his hands at it and slices it towards long off for a couple of runs
slower bumper outside off stump. Lomror walks across his stumps and heaves it towards short fine leg for just a single
slower delivery on a length way outside off stump. Lomror shuffles across further and somehow, via a combination of thigh pad and pad, gets it past Jitesh for four

taken at deep square leg! Dug into the track outside off stump, and this time, Karthik looks to drag it over cow corner. The ball is too far away to be playing that stroke, though, and all Karthik ends up doing is hitting it straight to Taide on the fence!
short, wide and punished! Too much width and it allows Karthik to slash at it and get it comfortably over the fielder at backward point!
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Lomror drills it straight to extra cover and settles for a single
Lomror breaks free! Low full toss outside off stump. Lomror pounces on the width, throws his hands at it and crashes it past extra cover for four!
another sizzling yorker just outside off stump. This time, Lomror is late in bringing his bat down and sees the ball fizz past the bottom of the bat
excellent yorker on off stump. Lomror gets his bat down in time and digs it out towards the bowler
back of a length delivery down the leg side. Karthik gets inside the line and glances it towards fine leg for a couple of runs

back of a length delivery on leg stump that seems to rush Lomror into his stroke. He misses his pull as the ball trickles off the thigh pad past the stumps. Enough to enable Karthik to sneak in a single
slower delivery on a full length just outside off stump. Lomror comes forward and pokes it back to the bowler

holes out to long off! Length delivery outside off stump. du Plessis looks to go inside out but does not quite get the timing he is after. He slices it off the bottom part of the bat and Curran does the rest on the fence. Massive, massive wicket in the context of the game!
clears long on! Off-pace delivery but this one sits up to be hit outside off stump. du Plessis waits for it and muscles it over long on!
slower delivery on a length just outside off stump. du Plessis advances and swings wildly, only connecting with fresh air in the process
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Karthik gets onto the back foot and cuts it straight to short extra cover
full and fast outside off stump. du Plessis backs away and drills it towards deep extra cover for one
shot! Length delivery fired into middle and off stump. du Plessis comes out of his bunker, swings through the line and bangs it over the sightscreen!
full delivery on middle and off stump. Karthik comes forward and pushes it down the ground towards long on to get off the mark

and Maxwell is out first ball! Tossed up on a full length on leg stump. Maxwell backs away and looks to tonk it into next week. He loses his shape completely, though, and slices it badly towards point. Taide settles under the high ball and completes the catch!

is that out? That was a brilliant take either way by Jitesh! Full and darted into middle and leg stump. Kohli gets across his stumps and looks for the paddle. He seems to get it right off the toe-end and the ball spoons up into the on side. Jitesh, anticipating the shot, is already moving in that direction and dives to his left to complete an excellent catch! Kohli is gone for 59 but those runs came off 47 balls, which will evoke plenty of discussion!
slower delivery angled across the batter outside off stump. du Plessis does well to reach it but because there is no pace to work with, he clogs it towards long off for a brace
another off-pace delivery on a back of a length on leg stump. Kohli heaves at it but does so too early, getting a bottom edge into the leg side
slower bumper just outside off stump. Kohli tries the upper cut but just does not have the pace to work with. Play and a miss!

dropped, oh dear! Dug into the track at the batter. du Plessis has a swipe at it and gets a massive top edge. The ball goes miles up. Jitesh circles underneath it and when it comes down with velocity, he grasses it
slower delivery on a back of a length outside off stump. Kohli tries to generate momentum by advancing but can only toe-end it towards long off
slower delivery on a length outside leg stump. du Plessis hoicks it away towards deep square leg for a single
oh dear! Very high full toss that nearly takes du Plessis' head off. He is bending down a little and in the end, does very well to get out of the way
low full toss on middle and leg stump. du Plessis plants his front foot and powers it down the ground for a single

slower bumper on leg stump. Kohli has a swipe at it and misses as the ball goes past his bat. Jitesh can't gather cleanly either and allows the single. But hang on, looks like RCB have reviewed this one, arguing that it should be a wide on height! And RCB are successful with their review again!
shot! In the slot outside off stump and Kohli cashes in! He bends his back knee, gets underneath it and creams it over wide long off for a maximum!
back of a length delivery angled into the stumps. Kohli is cramped for room and taps it back to the bowler
very full delivery outside off stump. du Plessis throws his hands at it, slips over and drills it towards deep cover point for a single
off-pace delivery on a back of a length outside off stump that does not come on at all. Kohli scuffs it into the leg side and gets across to the other end
slower delivery on a full length outside off stump. du Plessis does not pick it and is early into the stroke, dragging it on the bounce to deep mid wicket
shot! Breaks the shackles! Full delivery just outside off stump. Kohli dances down the track and creams it past extra cover. Gets to his half-century too, although this one has come off 40 balls!
full delivery outside off stump. du Plessis gets under it but can only clink it on the bounce to long off
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Kohli comes down the track and heaves it away towards deep mid wicket for just another single
yorker on middle and off stump. du Plessis clears his front leg but ends up shanking it towards long on for one

slower bumper outside off stump. du Plessis lets it go thinking the umpire will call it a wide but does not get the call. du Plessis has reviewed this one though, and looks like he might be vindicated. Called a wide!
full delivery fired into leg stump. Kohli seems to miss it as the ball pings off the pads into the on side for a single. Looks like Kohli might have gotten some bat on it
slower delivery on a full length outside off stump. du Plessis reaches out for it and drags it towards long on for a single
back of a length delivery on leg stump. du Plessis gets decent power on his pull but can't beat the sweeper at deep mid wicket
full delivery on off stump. Kohli lunges forward and drops it into the off side before scampering across to the other end
back of a length delivery on off stump. du Plessis goes back and heaves it away towards deep mid wicket
yorker on leg stump. Kohli jams it down the ground and ambles across to the other end
length delivery on middle and off stump. Kohli presses half forward and taps it towards backward point
back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump. du Plessis goes back and nudges it towards deep mid wicket
full delivery on middle and leg stump. du Plessis flicks it away towards deep mid wicket for one more run
slower delivery on a length on middle and off stump. Kohli gets forward and pushes it down the ground for a single
yorker on leg stump. Kohli jams his bat down in time and digs it out towards deep mid wicket. Places it well enough to come back for a brace
slower delivery dug into the track outside off stump. du Plessis gets up on his toes and flat-bats it towards long off for a single
slower delivery on a length on off stump. du Plessis hangs back and stabs it towards extra cover
back of a length delivery on leg stump. du Plessis gets inside the line of the ball but can't beat the fielder at short fine leg
length delivery angled into leg stump. du Plessis helps it towards deep mid wicket and immediately tells Kohli he is interested in just the single
shot! Short and way outside off stump. du Plessis nearly falls over while trying to reach it but somehow manages to crack it past cover point for four!
dragged down on off stump. Kohli gets onto the back foot and hacks it towards deep square leg for a single
tossed up on a full length outside off stump. Kohli reaches out for it and drives it towards extra cover
full delivery on off stump. Kohli lunges forward and pushes it towards short mid wicket
back of a length delivery on leg stump. du Plessis tucks it towards deep mid wicket
fuller just outside off stump. du Plessis eases it towards deep cover point and gets to his fifty, off just 31 balls!
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Kohli gets onto the back foot and jabs it towards deep cover point for an easy single
given a bit of air on a full length on leg stump. du Plessis jumps out to the leg side again before working it towards deep mid wicket
length delivery on off stump. Kohli waits in his crease and pushes it down the ground for one more run
full delivery just outside off stump. du Plessis comes forward and knocks it down the ground for a single
and he gets welcomed with a boundary! Short and on off stump. du Plessis has all the time in the world to free his arms and thump it over extra cover
back of a length delivery hung well outside off stump. du Plessis goes back and cuts it towards deep extra cover for another run
full delivery just outside off stump. Kohli plants his front foot and flicks it powerfully towards long on. Excellent work by Curran to keep it to a single
length delivery outside off stump. du Plessis backs away again but this time, slices it towards deep cover point for a single
flighted on a full length outside off stump. du Plessis backs away, reaches out for it and somehow manages to muscle it over the bowler's head for four!
length delivery outside off stump that spins away sharply. du Plessis goes wafting at it and is beaten on the outside
full delivery on middle and leg stump. Kohli drives it down the ground and picks up another single
clean as a whistle! Back of a length delivery on off stump and this one just sits up to be hit. du Plessis gives himself room and pumps it with a straight bat into the sightscreen!
length delivery slanted into leg stump. du Plessis uses the angle and flicks it towards fine leg. Arshdeep covers ground to his left, dives and pulls it back in
back of a length delivery on middle and off stump. du Plessis stands tall and punches it towards extra cover
full delivery just outside off stump. Kohli tips it down the ground and canters across to the other end
back of a length delivery on off stump that just sticks in the surface a little. du Plessis backs away and cloths it towards long on
back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump. Kohli advances and stabs it towards long on for a single
quicker and flatter on a length on off stump. Kohli waits in his crease and jabs it towards deep cover point for another single
full delivery on middle and off stump. Kohli presses forward and pushes it towards short extra cover
back of a length delivery outside off stump that grips and spins away. Kohli goes deep into his crease and defends
full delivery just outside off stump. Kohli gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it past short extra cover for a couple of runs
back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump. du Plessis backs away and punches it towards long off for one
length delivery just outside off stump. du Plessis comes half forward and pushes it towards backward point
slower delivery dug into the track on leg stump. du Plessis is early into his stroke and cops a blow on the body. The ball trickles away far enough into the off side for Kohli to sneak in a leg bye
full delivery on leg stump. Kohli bunts it down the ground and scampers across to the other end. Would have been close had the fielder hit the stumps!
banged into the track on leg stump. Kohli gets onto the back foot and pulls it away towards deep square leg for another brace
yorker fired into the batter's toes. du Plessis plays all over it as the ball pings off the back leg into the off side for a leg bye
shot! Back of a length delivery on leg stump. du Plessis opens up his stance, creates his own room and short-arm jabs it over mid wicket for four!
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Kohli comes down the track and works it into the leg side for a single
shot! Back of a length delivery just outside off stump. du Plessis waits in his crease again, opens his bat face and glides it past short third man for four!
back of a length delivery outside off stump. du Plessis waits deep in his crease and taps it towards cover
length delivery on off stump. Kohli advances and plonks it into the off side before calling his partner through for the single
four more! Dug into the track down the leg side. Kohli lets the ball come to him, rolls his wrists over it and pulls it past short fine leg
length delivery on off stump. Kohli comes down the track and laces his cover drive on the up. Can't beat short extra cover, though
slower delivery on a back of a length on off stump. du Plessis clears his front leg and heaves it towards deep square leg
back of a length delivery on leg stump. du Plessis gets onto the back foot and times it sweetly past mid on. The fielder gives chase and pulls it back but not before the batters complete three
six more! In the slot and on leg stump. du Plessis has enough swinging room and deposits it over the long on fence!
very full delivery darted into the batter's pads. du Plessis backs away again but can only squeeze it out towards mid on
du Plessis with his first six of the day! Flighted on a length on middle and off stump. du Plessis gives himself plenty of room and lifts it effortlessly over the bowler's head!
full delivery on middle and off stump. Kohli lunges forward and drives it down the ground for one more run
angled into the stumps. du Plessis uses the pace and works it into the leg side for one
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Kohli advances and dabs it uppishly towards backward point. It bounces just in front of the fielder and then bobbles away into the fence
length delivery just outside off stump. Kohli gets onto the front foot confidently and pushes it past extra cover for a couple of runs
bumper outside off stump that zips through. Kohli thinks about the pull before bailing out of it at the last moment
four more! Back of a length delivery on leg stump that climbs onto Kohli. He gets inside the line and does enough to help it over short fine leg
low full toss on off stump. du Plessis does not get the timing he is after and scuffs it towards mid off for a single
full delivery on middle and off stump. du Plessis gets forward and defends it back to the bowler
length delivery on middle and leg stump that holds in the surface a touch. Kohli turns it into the leg side
full delivery outside off stump. Kohli presses forward and pushes it towards short extra cover
gets it through! Flighted on a full length outside off stump. Kohli gets to the pitch of the ball and threads it past extra cover for four!
full delivery on off stump. du Plessis gives himself a bit of room and knocks it down the ground for a single
back of a length delivery just outside off stump that spins away. Kohli goes back and works it towards deep mid wicket
full and outside off stump. Kohli drives it straight to extra cover
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Kohli lets the ball come to him before tucking it off his hips towards deep backward square leg
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Kohli takes a step down the track and punches it past cover point for a couple of runs
length delivery on middle and leg stump that curves in late. du Plessis plays all around it as the ball pings off the back thigh into the off side
back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump. du Plessis gets up on his toes and defends into the off side. Kohli wants the single but is sent back
banged into the track on middle and off stump. du Plessis gauges the line and the length early and sways out of the way
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Kohli taps it into the off side and calls du Plessis through for the single

taken at backward point! RCB win by 24 runs! Slower delivery on a length well outside off stump. Jitesh tries to reach out and looks to go over extra cover. He does not quite pick the variation, though, and swings too early, skewing it off the toe-end towards backward point. The fielder judges it well, dives forward and completes the catch!
yorker on middle and off stump. Jitesh gets decent power behind it but drills it straight back into the stumps at the other end
back of a length delivery way outside off stump. Jitesh swishes and misses but then sees the umpire indulge in a bit of exercise

cleans him up with a corker! Full delivery slanted into leg stump. Ellis is caught on the crease and has a hopeful waft at it. Gets nowhere close to the ball, though, and it sends leg stump cartwheeling! What a spell this has been from Siraj, and RCB are now just one wicket away from victory!
slower delivery on a back of a length outside off stump. Jitesh winds up and drags it towards long on for a single

full delivery on middle and off stump. Ellis taps it into the off side and it looks like there is no run there. Hasaranga, though, fires it at the batter's end and the ball hits the stumps, allowing Jitesh to get across due to the deflection

Siraj gets Brar! Back of a length delivery on middle and off stump that skids through. Brar has a slog across the line and gets nowhere close to the ball as it smashes into the stumps! Siraj with a crucial breakthrough for RCB!
slower delivery on a back of a length outside off stump. Jitesh throws his hands at it and misses. Karthik fumbles too and concedes a bye
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Brar hacks it away into the on side for a single

dropped, oh dear! Full toss outside off stump. Jitesh heaves at it and miscues it towards long on. Kohli comes under it but then he spots Prabhudessai coming in from deep mid wicket too. In the end, Kohli puts it down
full delivery on middle and off stump. Brar plants his front foot but can only chip it towards long off for one
slower delivery on a full length outside off stump. Jitesh winds up and powers it down the ground for a single
full delivery into the pads. Brar uses the pace and tucks it away towards deep backward square leg for one more run
very full delivery outside off stump. Jitesh takes a step down the track and drills it towards long off for one more run
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Brar gets up on his toes and punches it down the ground for a single
very full delivery on middle and off stump. Brar comes forward and drives it back past the bowler for a single

nearly! Slower delivery on a back of a length outside off stump. Jitesh drills it towards extra cover and sets off for the single. Has to stretch to make his ground and is saved by Siraj missing his shy at the bowler's end
length delivery way outside off stump. Jitesh walks across and tries the reverse ramp but makes no connection
six more! Clean strike! Another slot ball and Jitesh capitalises! Opens up his stance and pounds it into the sightscreen!
shot! In the slot outside off stump. Jitesh gives himself a bit of room, throws his hands at it and carves it over extra cover for four!
length delivery on middle and off stump. Brar pokes it towards long on and gets across to the other end
dragged down on leg stump. Jitesh rocks back and pulls it away towards deep mid wicket. Prabhudessai dives forward, looking for the catch but can't quite get to it
length delivery darted into leg stump. Jitesh has another swipe at it and misses as the ball hits the pads
googly on a back of a length outside off stump. Brar goes back and eases it towards deep mid wicket for another single
full delivery just outside off stump. Jitesh has a wild slog at it and skews it off the outside edge towards short third man

in the air, and over the sightscreen! Tossed up into the slot, and it was only a matter of time before Jitesh tried the big hit. Does not get it right out of the middle but enough wood to comfortably clear the sightscreen!
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Brar goes back and turns it towards deep mid wicket for a single
excellent yorker slanted into leg stump. Jitesh falls over while trying to dig it out and only gets it as far as his pads. Might have gotten an inside edge there!
slower delivery on a full length on middle and leg stump. Brar comes forward and works it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length delivery on off stump that cramps Brar for room. He tries to ramp it over the keeper's head but misses the ball altogether
yorker just outside off stump. Brar gets his bat down in time and digs it out towards the bowler
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Jitesh dabs it towards backward point for a single
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Jitesh stands up tall and pulls it away towards deep mid wicket for a brace
edged and four! Flighted nicely on a full length just outside off stump. Brar goes searching for it and gets an inside edge that evades the stumps and races away past short fine leg

Shahrukh runs at Hasaranga, and gets stumped by a mile! Googly tossed up on a length just outside off stump. Shahrukh comes down the track and has a wild slog at it. He misses the ball by quite some distance and Karthik does the rest by whipping off the bails!
length delivery on leg stump. Jitesh tucks it off his pads towards deep mid wicket and wants the second. Shahrukh, though, is not interested
full delivery on leg stump. Shahrukh lunges forward and turns it behind square on the leg side for a single
dragged down on middle and leg stump. Jitesh goes back and heaves it on the bounce to deep mid wicket
googly on a full length on middle and off stump. Jitesh comes half forward and pushes it into the off side
Shahrukh is underway! In the slot and this time, Shahrukh goes after it! Plants his front foot and pummels it over the bowler's head for six!
dropped, oh my! Full and darted into the stumps. Shahrukh smashes it back to the bowler, who gets his hands to it but can't hold on. That came back to him very quickly
full delivery on off stump. Shahrukh comes forward and pokes it back to the bowler

off stump out of the ground! Full delivery angled into off stump. Prabhsimran advances and looks to carve it over the off side. This time, though, he does not make any contact and the ball breezes past the bat before sending off stump flying! Good innings by Prabhsimran and it has kept PBKS in the game, although his team would have wanted him to carry on!
six more! Back of a length delivery on leg stump. Prabhsimran shuffles across and helps it over short fine leg for another maximum! RCB have conceded too many sixes over that region today!
full delivery slanted into middle and leg stump. Jitesh comes forward and pushes it down the ground for a single
yorker on middle and leg stump. Jitesh has a massive swing at it and squirts it off the inside edge past short fine leg for a single
out of the park! That is a No ball for height too! Waist-high full toss on leg stump, and that ought to travel! Jitesh obliges by stepping inside the line and smashing it over fine leg

huge appeal, and given! Full toss darted into leg stump. Jitesh walks across his stumps and looks to access the leg side. In theory, that seems the perfect plan. The only problem, though, is that he has missed a rank full toss on his pads. It hits him half-way up on the front pad and the umpire raises his finger! No bat involved, but hang on.....Ball Tracking reckons that that would have gone past leg stump! Jitesh survives!
shot! Short and wide outside off stump. Jitesh picks up the length and the change in pace before slapping it over extra cover for four!
back of a length delivery angled into leg stump. Jitesh is cramped for room and only manages to inside-edge his pull stroke into his thigh pad
yorker on middle and leg stump. Prabhsimran digs it out towards long on and collects another single
slower delivery dug into the track outside off stump. Prabhsimran advances and wafts at it but makes no contact at all
very full delivery angled into leg stump. Prabhsimran takes a step down the track and pushes it into the on side for an easy single

Curran has been run out too! Yorker outside off stump. Curran digs it out into the off side and sets off for the single. He is a little lethargic in his running, though, and in fact, he is short of his ground as the fielder fires a direct hit at the bowler's end! That is the last thing Curran and PBKS needed at this stage
shot! Length delivery hung outside off stump. Curran sits deep in his crease, gets his hands through the ball and cracks it past extra cover for four
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Prabhsimran comes down the track and flat-bats it towards mid off for one more run
length delivery outside off stump. Curran has another swing at it and ends up tugging it towards long on for a single
slower delivery on a back of a length on leg stump. Curran heaves at it but is too early into the stroke, copping a blow on the thigh in the process
six more! This is massive! Another googly on a full length on middle and leg stump. Prabhsimran picks it again, marches down the track and whacks it over wide long on!
length delivery on off stump. Curran hangs back and punches it towards long on for a single
back of a length delivery on off stump. Prabhsimran goes back and turns it towards deep square leg for one
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Prabhsimran goes back and punches it straight to extra cover

safe! Given a bit of air on a length on middle and leg stump. Prabhsimran tries the switch hit but makes a hash of it. The ball skews off the top edge but lands just in front of Harshal, who is rushing in from short third
and he gets deposited over long on! In the slot on middle and off stump. Prabhsimran dances down the track, picks the googly and launches it over long on!
dug into the track on middle and off stump. This one does not get up as much but Curran still manages to duck underneath it
length delivery angled across the batter outside off stump. Curran scuffs it towards mid off
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Curran has a waft at it and chunks it off the inner half of the bat towards the bowler
full toss on off stump. Prabhsimran punches it down the ground for a single
slower yorker on off stump. Prabhsimran comes forward and prods it back to the bowler
full delivery on middle and leg stump. Curran comes forward and flicks it towards deep mid wicket for a single
length delivery just outside off stump. Curran knocks it down the ground and canters across to the other end
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Prabhsimran gets onto the back foot and stabs it towards long off
back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump. Curran waits in his crease and works it towards deep mid wicket
length delivery on leg stump. Prabhsimran goes back and eases it into the leg side for a single
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Cut straight to backward point
length delivery on middle and leg stump. Curran pokes it back to Maxwell, who misfields and concedes a single
streaky but it is six! Back of a length delivery on leg stump that seems to hold in the surface a shade. Prabhsimran has a swipe at it and gets a top edge that flies over the fine leg fence
length delivery on middle and leg stump. Prabhsimran tucks it towards mid wicket and this time, he sets off for the single, only to be sent back by his skipper
full delivery angled into middle and leg stump. Prabhsimran comes forward and pushes it towards mid on

Bhatia has been run out by Siraj! Oh dear! Back of a length delivery at the stumps. Prabhsimran is cramped for room and plonks it towards mid off. Bhatia, in the meantime, has wandered down the track, only to be sent back. That, though, gives Siraj enough time to take aim and throw down the stumps at the bowler's end!
back of a length delivery that slides down the leg side. Prabhsimran swings and misses but then sees the umpire indulge in a bit of exercise
short and wide outside off stump. Bhatia waits in his crease and laces his square cut to deep cover point
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Prabhsimran cuts it powerfully towards short extra cover, who misfields and concedes a single
what a shot! Fractionally short on off stump. Bhatia picks up the length in a flash, rocks back and belts it over the deep square leg fence!
slower delivery dug into the track outside off stump. Bhatia looks to dab it away but is very early into his stroke. Makes no contact whatsoever
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Prabhsimran takes a step down the track and nurdles it into the leg side for a single
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Bhatia pokes it into the off side and dashes across to the other end
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Bhatia has a waft at it away from his body and seems to be beaten for pace
length delivery fired down the leg side. Bhatia looks to heave it away but is too early into the stroke that he chalks it, and the ball drops right beside him
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Prabhsimran gets onto the back foot and defends into the off side
length delivery just outside off stump. Bhatia drops it into the leg side and Prabhsimran is alert enough to hare across for the single
gets off the mark with four! Length delivery on leg stump. Bhatia gets inside the line of the ball and glances it fine past the keeper
full delivery angled across just outside off stump. Bhatia comes half forward and prods it into the off side

length delivery angled into middle and off stump. Livingstone charges, hacks across the line and misses as the ball pings into his pads.RCB have a long discussion before Kohli, Karthik and Siraj decide to go upstairs! That could be a lot closer than it first looked. No bat involved but Livingstone is way down the track. But it does not matter. Ball Tracking shows that the ball would have thundered into the top of leg stump, and Livingstone, despite being bewildered, has to go!
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Livingstone gets up on his toes and stabs it into the leg side
very full delivery down the leg side. Prabhsimran has a swipe at it and gets enough bat to beat short fine leg and collect another boundary!
full delivery on off stump. Prabhsimran lunges forward and defends it back to the bowler
length delivery on middle and leg stump. Livingstone tucks it off his pads towards mid wicket and saunters across to the other end
another googly on a back of a length on middle and leg stump. Prabhsimran goes back and works it into the on side for one
googly on a length on middle and leg stump. Livingstone knocks it down the ground and gets off the mark

Short tries, but perishes! Googly tossed up on a full length on middle and off stump. Short hares down the track without pocking the length and then has a wild slog at it. Misses it by a distance and the ball knocks back leg stump! Just the start Hasaranga would have been after!
four more! Short and down the leg side. Prabhsimran has all the time in the world to swivel and hammer it past long leg for a boundary!
full delivery outside off stump. Short tries to force it through the off side but ends up shanking it towards mid wicket. The fielder, though, misfields and allows the single
what a shot! Back of a length delivery on leg stump. Short picks up the length very early and dumps it well over the fine leg fence!
full delivery outside off stump. Short throws his hands at it but chunks it off the inner half of the bat towards the bowler
back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump that does not come on as quickly as Short expects. Swings too early and is pinned on the back thigh
short and angled across the batter outside off stump. Short has a swipe across the line but does not make any contact
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Prabhsimran gets up on his toes and punches it towards short extra cover
four more! Back of a length delivery down the leg side. Prabhsimran gets inside the line early and tickles it fine past the keeper
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Prabhsimran gets behind the line of the ball and taps it into the off side
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Short gets up on his toes and runs it down to third man for a single

huge appeal, not given! Full delivery on middle and leg stump that shapes into the batter late. Taide falls over a touch and seems to play all around it as the ball strikes the pads. The umpire says no but RCB review. No bat involved. Is it going over the top, though? No, it is not! Three reds, and Taide has to go!
what a way to get off the mark! Back of a length delivery on leg stump. Taide lets the ball come to him before clipping it delightfully off his hips past square leg for four!
